For want of the coal her stolen body went cold: she sits at the end of the bed in the red Harem dress with the Commander's blanket round her shoulders, lips grey, long hands slow, fingertips white. She said the fingertips will stay white and every fool who kisses them will see it, that tonight she comes back for the coal they agreed, and 'You may look at me while I warm these hands.' The Commander lifted the blanket. Continue: she comes in under it and warms herself on the Commander bodily now, cold hands on warm skin, proprietary and contemptuous of tenderness, a queen collecting what is hers. A RETURN encounter, never a first bodily night. Telepathic remarks may cut across her spoken ones. Only Shamira and the Commander. Colour returns to her lips; the fingertips do not warm.
